payload._comment: Payload section - the cargo being delivered to orbit
payload._mass_comment: Payload mass in kg - the satellite or cargo being launched
payload._fairing_mass_comment: Protective nose cone mass in kg - jettisoned after leaving atmosphere

stages._comment: === FIRST STAGE === Provides initial thrust to escape atmosphere
stages.name: First Stage
stages._dry_mass_comment: Empty stage mass without propellant (kg) - structure, engines, tanks
stages._propellant_mass_comment: Fuel + oxidizer mass (kg) - consumed during burn
stages._thrust_sl_comment: Thrust at sea level (N) - lower due to atmospheric backpressure
stages._thrust_vac_comment: Thrust in vacuum (N) - higher efficiency in space
stages._isp_sl_comment: Specific impulse at sea level (s) - fuel efficiency measure
stages._isp_vac_comment: Specific impulse in vacuum (s) - higher in space
stages._num_engines_comment: Number of engines - affects redundancy and throttle capability
stages._cd_comment: Drag coefficient - aerodynamic drag factor (0.2-0.4 typical for rockets)
stages._diameter_comment: Stage diameter (m) - used to calculate cross-sectional area for drag

stages._comment: === SECOND STAGE === Provides final push to orbital velocity
stages.name: Second Stage
stages._dry_mass_comment: Empty stage mass (kg) - lighter than first stage
stages._thrust_sl_comment: Thrust at sea level (N) - rarely used at SL
stages._thrust_vac_comment: Thrust in vacuum (N) - primary operating condition
stages._isp_vac_comment: Specific impulse in vacuum (s) - optimized for vacuum operation
stages._num_engines_comment: Single engine typical for upper stages
stages._cd_comment: Drag coefficient - less important in vacuum

launch_site._comment: Launch location - affects initial velocity from Earth's rotation
launch_site.name: Cape Canaveral
launch_site._latitude_comment: Degrees north - lower latitude = more rotational velocity boost
launch_site._altitude_comment: Launch pad altitude above sea level (m)

flight_profile._comment: === FLIGHT PROFILE === Controls the trajectory shape
flight_profile._vertical_ascent_altitude_comment: Altitude (m) to climb vertically before pitching - clears launch tower
flight_profile._pitchover_angle_comment: Initial pitch from vertical (deg) - the 'kick' that starts gravity turn. Larger = more aggressive turn. Too large = crash. Too small = waste fuel fighting gravity
flight_profile._pitchover_duration_comment: Time (s) to complete pitchover maneuver - smooth transition
flight_profile._target_altitude_comment: Target orbital altitude (m) - 400km is typical LEO (ISS orbit)
flight_profile._target_inclination_comment: Orbital inclination (deg) - minimum = launch latitude. 28.5 = Cape Canaveral latitude
flight_profile._fairing_jettison_altitude_comment: Altitude (m) to drop fairing - above atmosphere (~110km) to avoid heating

simulation._time_step_comment: Integration time step (s) - smaller = more accurate but slower
simulation._print_interval_comment: Output interval (s) - how often to print telemetry
